column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:emitlang module + the core `emit` word
# `emit <kind> <opts?> <data>` is the symmetric inverse of `parse`: it expands
# at the call site to the STANDARD emitter call
# `EmitLang get emit_<kind> <data> <opts> end`. The `data` is the REQUIRED LAST
# surface arg and `opts` is the optional MIDDLE one — disambiguated by arity.
# The kind is OPTIONAL: bare `emit <data>` routes to emit_auto, which picks the
# value's natural format (Map/List/scalar/Error → json, Table → csv, Xml → xml).
# Every emitter traverses the value through the canonical walk engine — one code
# path for all formats. `EmitLang.register` installs AQL fns as emitters;
# `EmitLang.kinds` lists them. A shape a format cannot represent raises
# emit_unsupported; an unknown explicit kind raises emit_unknown_lang.
# (Emit results are Strings, so the canonical expected form is single-quoted.)
# §1  emit — auto (natural format) and explicit json

column3: bare emit auto-picks json for a Map
a List auto-emits as a json array
a scalar String auto-emits as json

column1: aql:emitlang import end  emit json {a:1 b:"hi"}
column3: explicit json kind
emit is pure sugar — the desugared standard call is equivalent
opts {pretty:true} → indented json (2-space default)
opts {indent:N} → N-space indentation
an explicit empty opts map → compact (the default)

column1: aql:emitlang import end  emit jsonic {a:1 b:"hi"}
column3: jsonic drops quotes for identifier keys

column1: aql:emitlang import end  emit jsonic {"a b":1}
column3: a non-identifier key stays quoted
a flat map renders one key: value line
a list renders `- ` items

column1: # §5  csv / tsv — tabular, list of records
aql:emitlang import end  emit csv [{a:1 b:2} {a:3 b:4}]
column3: csv header from the first record's keys, then rows

column1: aql:emitlang import end  emit tsv [{a:1 b:2}]
column3: tsv uses a tab separator

column1: aql:emitlang import end  emit csv {separation:";"} [{a:1 b:2}]
column3: opts {separation:sep} overrides the csv separator

column1: aql:emitlang import end  emit toml {a:1 b:"hi"}
column3: a flat map → top-level key = value lines
a nested map → a [table] header
a {section:{k:v}} map → an [section] block

column1: aql:emitlang import end  emit ini {a:1 b:2}
column3: a flat map → bare key=value lines
an Xml element round-trips to well-formed XML

column2: [json/q jsonic/q yaml/q csv/q tsv/q toml/q ini/q xml/q]
column3: the registered emitter-kind atoms (the built-in family, in fixed order)

column1: aql:emitlang import end  EmitLang.register up (fn [[value:Any opts:Map] [String] ["UP"]]) end  emit up {a:1}
column3: register installs a custom emitter; emit <name> uses it
unknown explicit kind: expansion-time error at the call site
emit is core but emitters need the import (no auto-import)
the namespace is unbound until imported
toml cannot represent a top-level List
xml only emits an Xml element, not a Map
ini supports one level of sections, not deeper nesting

column3: capitalised emitter names are rejected (types)
the standard prefix [value:Any opts:Map …] is enforced

column1: aql:emitlang import end  EmitLang.register emit_x (fn [[value:Any opts:Map] [String] ["x"]])
column3: the emit_ prefix is register's job, not the caller's

column1: aql:emitlang import end  EmitLang.register json (fn [[value:Any opts:Map] [String] ["x"]])

column3: emit_auto picks the value's natural format (json for a Map)
emit_jsonic — bare identifier keys
emit_yaml — block style

column1: aql:emitlang import end  EmitLang.emit_csv [{a:1 b:2}] {} end

emit_toml — key = value
emit_ini — flat key=value
